heroHeadline: IDF Officer Killed in Clash with Hezbollah Gunman in South Lebanon
heroSubtitle: An Israeli Defense Forces officer was killed in a clash with a Hezbollah gunman in southern Lebanon, marking a significant escalation amid the fragile ceasefire. Iran links Strait of Hormuz closure to Lebanon ceasefire conditions and oil waivers.
